meta.title: When was the line you keep obeying written? | Meditation: Sitting with the Old Note
meta.description:
This is a fifteen minute guided meditation for rereading an old note, a limit, or a silence. You will be given a quiet way to add its date and let it rest.

For a Mercury retrograde, when astrology reads a time to slow down and reread. Sit with one old note and give it its date.

A slow sitting with one old record, hearing its present tense as the day it was written, so the note is dated rather than discarded or obeyed.

Read the words at https://achurch.ai/docs/meditations/meditation-sitting-with-the-old-note

0:00 I
3:47 II
8:36 III
